macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks rebound sharply as tech leads rally
items.summary: The Dow rose 1.18%, the S&P 500 gained 1.6%, and the Nasdaq climbed 2.31% on Friday, producing the major indexes’ strongest weekly gains since April 2025. The rebound followed a volatile month dominated by concerns about AI valuations and interest rates.

items.title: Markets price near-certain December Fed rate hike
items.summary: Interest-rate futures were pricing in roughly a 99% probability of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate increase in December. Investors are also focused on upcoming U.S. employment data and its implications for the Fed’s policy path.

items.title: Asian shares recover as dollar strengthens
items.summary: Asian equities extended their rebound after a difficult month, while the dollar headed toward a third consecutive monthly gain amid safe-haven demand and expectations for higher U.S. interest rates. Japan’s stronger Tokyo core inflation increased expectations of a possible Bank of Japan hike as soon as next month.

items.title: China market-support pledge lifts regional sentiment
items.summary: Chinese benchmark shares reportedly rose more than 3% after Beijing pledged stronger support for markets, helping reinforce a broader risk-on move across Asian equities.

items.title: AI investment concerns continue to drive volatility
items.summary: Investors remain concerned about whether massive AI infrastructure spending will generate adequate returns, contributing to sharp swings in semiconductor and technology shares. Nvidia also faced a potential credit-rating downgrade watch and reported restrictions on shipping some servers to Southeast Asian markets.

items.title: European stocks rebound as tariff fears ease
items.summary: European equities rallied, with the Stoxx 600 up 1.8%, the DAX rising 2.1%, the Euro Stoxx 50 gaining 2%, and the FTSE 100 advancing 1.8%. Investors became less concerned about the economic impact of proposed U.S. tariffs.

items.title: Marvell earnings strengthen semiconductor focus
items.summary: Marvell Technology was identified as a significant upcoming earnings catalyst for the technology sector, while reports said its fiscal third-quarter results beat expectations and its shares rose sharply.

items.title: Eurozone inflation expectations rise as ECB leadership changes
items.summary: Eurozone consumers sharply increased their inflation expectations, potentially strengthening the case for tighter European Central Bank policy. Markets also focused on the nomination of a successor to ECB President Christine Lagarde.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ether and Solana recover modestly
items.summary: Bitcoin traded around $61,490, up roughly 0.8% over 24 hours, while Ether rose about 1.9% to $1,735 and Solana gained about 2.4% to $72.84.[1]

items.title: Monero suffers sharp drop amid delisting pressure
items.summary: Monero fell roughly 10% after declining more than 15% intraday, with KuCoin reportedly preparing to delist XMR on November 30.[1]

items.title: EU and Asian governments advance crypto-regulatory coordination
items.summary: The EU moved to expand crypto-related sanctions involving Kyrgyzstan, while China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN agreed to establish a working group on cross-border digital payments and digital-asset regulation.[1]

items.title: Spain considers crypto-account freezing powers
items.summary: Spain moved toward granting its financial intelligence unit authority to freeze crypto accounts without prior judicial authorization.[1]

items.title: Japan weighs tighter DeFi and self-custody oversight
items.summary: Japan’s financial regulator published discussion papers examining possible rules for decentralized-finance front ends and unhosted wallets.[1]

items.title: Solana launches AI-assisted browser development environment
items.summary: Solana introduced an AI-powered Playground that lets developers create, test and deploy blockchain applications in a browser without installing local software.[1]

items.title: Ethereum Glamsterdam upgrade gets Hoodi testnet date
items.summary: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade was reported to be scheduled for testing on the Hoodi testnet on December 15.[1]

items.title: U.S. seeks recovery of $1.1 billion in Binance hack funds
items.summary: The U.S. Justice Department is pursuing more than $1.1 billion in USDC allegedly stolen in a Binance-related hack.[1]

items.title: Ukraine advances crypto-market legalization
items.summary: Ukraine’s parliament passed legislation intended to legalize the crypto market and establish its tax framework.[1]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Warframe Tau update detailed ahead of December launch
items.summary: Digital Extremes revealed new details about Warframe’s Tau update, described as a major expansion featuring a new solar system and additional gameplay features. The update is scheduled for December 9, 2026.

items.title: PMGC 2026 Gauntlet begins with 16 teams
items.summary: The PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2026 Gauntlet began with 16 teams competing for six places in the Grand Finals. India’s Team Soul is among the participating teams.

items.title: PGL Major Singapore reports strong opening-day viewership
items.summary: PGL Major Singapore 2026 recorded a reported peak of 455,489 viewers on its opening day, with FaZe Clan versus G.O.S.H. attracting the most attention.

items.title: BLAST Slam IX playoffs get underway
items.summary: The BLAST Slam IX playoffs began with six teams competing, while Team Yandex and PARIVISION secured direct places in the upper-bracket semifinals.

items.title: Ubisoft reportedly establishes AI-focused gaming subsidiary
items.summary: Ubisoft is reported to have created Motherbrain, a subsidiary focused on generative artificial intelligence applications in gaming.

items.title: Supercell extraction shooter returns to mobile soft launch
items.summary: Supercell’s extraction shooter reportedly reappeared on the App Store and Google Play in selected markets including the United States, Canada, Mexico, Malaysia, and the Philippines.

items.title: FC 27 adds AI-assisted John Motson commentary
items.summary: EA Sports FC 27 reportedly includes the late football commentator John Motson as an optional voice, combining archival recordings with AI-generated commentary.

items.title: GTA VI reported as PlayStation’s biggest launch
items.summary: Sony reportedly said more than 39 million unique PlayStation 5 players played Grand Theft Auto VI during its first four days, alongside record gameplay hours and increased console connections.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.

items.title: WhatsApp to add in-app travel eSIM purchases
items.summary: WhatsApp is preparing an in-app travel eSIM purchasing feature that will initially roll out in select countries, allowing users to buy connectivity for international trips directly within the app.

items.title: Samsung brings new health tools to Galaxy Watch8
items.summary: Samsung is rolling out additional health features to the Galaxy Watch8 through its One UI 9 software update, expanding the smartwatch’s wellness and monitoring capabilities.

items.title: 1Password reports breach of internal systems
items.summary: 1Password said attackers breached internal systems, while the company stated that customer passwords remain safe.

items.title: Microsoft removes WSUS server role from Windows Server 2028
items.summary: Microsoft is removing the Windows Server Update Services role from Windows Server 2028, requiring organizations to consider alternative update-management approaches.

items.title: Huawei found guilty in US criminal case
items.summary: A US jury convicted Huawei in a criminal case involving allegations that the company misled banks about its business connected to Iran.

items.title: GTA VI reportedly drives PlayStation 5 demand
items.summary: Recent reporting says anticipation for Grand Theft Auto VI has contributed to PlayStation 5 shortages and increased sales in markets worldwide.

items.title: HKC launches 420Hz Mini LED gaming monitor
items.summary: HKC introduced the Shield 27Q420B, a 27-inch gaming monitor featuring a 420Hz refresh rate and Mini LED backlighting aimed at competitive esports players.
